cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Consequences Compound
cards.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Our table-tennis rematch decides who cleans up.

mechanism: A claims the right to set consequences, treating each response as permission to enlarge the cost or audience of a choice.
confusable: Distinguish generic bossiness from an observable increase in stakes across A1, A3 and A5.
comparison: A rematch expands from chores to annual methods and public dispute; a snack selection expands into personal reputational exposure.
seedUse: Use canonical rematch and biscuit seeds, with S01 expressed in assigning consequences; inspect who forms the committee impression rather than inheriting ambiguous wording.
